title: Sake-Glazed Idli with Jaggery and Zingy Twist
description: A sweet and savory twist on traditional idli with a sake glaze and a hint of jaggery.

ingredients.name: Zingy syrup (ginger-mint syrup or simple syrup with ginger and mint)

instructions: 1. Prepare the idli according to the package instructions.
2. Reduce the sake by half to create a glaze.
3. Mix the jaggery and sake glaze in a saucepan over low heat until combined.
4. Brush the idli with the sake glaze and top with crushed jaggery.
5. Drizzle the zingy syrup over the idli.
6. Serve warm or at room temperature.
